events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the diagnostic and secure data access
events.decision: Will the CEO and Export Director open access to export pricing, invoice and payment data?
agenda: Present the question on 2025 export margins and the 8-week diagnostic
Discuss the pricing, invoice and payment data the work needs
Confirm who supplies the data and who the team speaks with

events.label: Workshop: first findings
events.purpose: Review first price and distributor findings
events.decision: Which markets and distributor terms should the final findings detail?
agenda: Present interim 2025 price and margin by export market
Present distributor terms checked against invoices and payments
Discuss which markets and terms the final findings should detail

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Present findings and close the diagnostic
events.decision: Do the CEO and Export Director accept the findings on why export margins fell?
agenda: Present the findings on why 2025 export margins fell
Review the pricing practice and price list review by market
Decide whether to accept the findings
